threads.summary: onEnvoyRoleRegained registered at legionExtension(pi) setup; a task subagent's in-process re-bind (oh-my-pi sdk.ts bindPreparedExtensions) overwrites the single bridge slot with a no-op listener, so the controller's regain never re-runs /controller/ready after its first task call. Reproduced with a throwaway copy of the controller regain test plus a second legionExtension(createPi().pi) + subagent session_start: soft claim sent, controller/ready count stays 1. Fix: register from claimController/bootstrapRoot once identity exists; add that regression test; correct envoy.ts:90 premise.

Hook awaited inside the heartbeat chain before .finally releases `healing`; daemon-client.ts:108 fetch has no timeout; /controller/ready awaits drainControllerNotices (events.ts:572-610, unbounded attempts) + forced resync. A stuck drain/resync pins healing=true, registerSession() stops, registry TTL lapses, session deaf. Fix: fire the hook off the chain with its own catch (or from .finally after healing=false); regression test: never-settling hook, next tick still POSTs /v1/interests/subscribe.
afterOutage derived from any chain rejection; a reassertRole-internal failure (getRole 5xx) yields a spurious 'reregistered' ready call next tick. Track registerSession failure separately.

sessionID read live across awaits; a session rebind racing a tick can 409 against the process's own new id and drop the valid claim / dangle the old-id claim. Capture id at entry and guard like claimedRoleTopic.
Controller branch lacks callReadyWithRetry (root branch has it); L516 comment overstates retry. Wrap once the hook is off the heartbeat chain.
History narration in comment ('until now ... a human re-ran envoy_role_set').
History narration in test comment ('tonight's incident').
